item.title: dotnet: Blazor Welcomes Open-Source Contributions from Syncfusion
item.description:
Microsoft and Syncfusion are collaborating on Blazor via a free open-source component toolkit, framework contributions, and developer tooling. The post says these contributions are now part of the Blazor ecosystem.

  • Source: .NET
